crossRefs.note: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
“If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I…
In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the…
No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
He who sees me sees him who sent me.
But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing…
and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

translations.web: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
translations.bsb: My ears had heard of You, but now my eyes have seen You.
translations.kjv: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth
translations.asv: I had heard of thee by the hearing of the ear; But now mine eye seeth thee:
